item.title: Disabled neighbor finally moves back into apartment after elevator fixed
item.description: Donna Beam is happy to be back in her apartment after the elevator in her senior apartment building was broken for several weeks, but she says she's worried it will break down again.

item.title: Minden approved for FEMA grant to rebuild water treatment plant destroyed in tornado
item.description: It's been almost two years since the Arbor Day tornadoes, but only this week did Minden learn it's been approved for a FEMA grant to rebuild it's water treatment facility.

item.title: Mother of girl killed in Fremont plant explosion sues Horizon Biofuels over deadly blast
item.description: Lauren Baker filed a lawsuit against Horizon Biofuels, alleging dust caused the July 2025 explosion that killed her daughter Hayven, 12, her sister Fayeah, 8, and their father, Dylan Danielson.
